rows.scope: Create two-dimensional shapes using specified attributes, including numbers of sides and vertices.

Classify and sort three-dimensional solids by attributes using formal geometry terms; include spheres, cones, cylinders, rectangular prisms (including cubes as special rectangular prisms), and triangular prisms.
Classify and sort polygons with at most 12 sides by attributes, including counting sides and vertices.
Compose two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional solids with specified properties or attributes.

Decompose two-dimensional shapes and identify the resulting parts; publisher illustrations include a rectangle with a square removed, a bisected shape, and a rectangle partitioned into identical triangles.
